name: Scrubbable numbers / reactive document
definition: Numbers in the text that you drag to change, with the dependent figures updating live.

demo.how: The blue numbers are inputs: drag one left or right, or focus it and press the arrow keys, and every dependent figure in the sentence plus the twelve-month bars recompute at once. Monthly revenue = new teams × 12 months × seats × price; annual run rate = that × 12. Reset restores the defaults.
